### God Enters the Tabernacle
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-enters-tabernacle
Passage: Exodus 40:34-38
Points:
- Moses received instructions for the tabernacle so God could visibly dwell in the midst of Israel.
- God's dwelling among His people begins restoring the intimate communion lost in Eden through human sin.
- Unlike on Mount Sinai, the Lord's presence traveled with Israel throughout their journey toward Canaan.
- The tabernacle was limited and provisional, as ongoing sin barred ordinary people from entering God's presence.
- Christ fulfills the tabernacle by securing direct, open communion with the Father for all believers.
